title: EgoUseBench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents under Evolving First-Person Contexts
abstract: arXiv:2611.34466v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI wearables, such as smart glasses, extend the context available to agents beyond digital environments to users' physical surroundings. With these devices, computer tasks can originate from users' ongoing activities rather than solely from explicit instructions. Through first-person observations, agents can identify objects and activities relevant to user requests and ground digital tasks in the surrounding context. We call this interaction paradigm Ego Use. However, first-person observations are limited by the wearer's viewpoint and may provide incomplete or ambiguous evidence of ongoing activities. As new observations arrive, agents may need to revise their understanding of the physical context and user intent, and reassess whether prior digital actions remain valid. translated_title: EgoUseBench：在演化的第一人称情境下对计算机使用智能体进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 诸如智能眼镜之类的AI可穿戴设备，将智能体可利用的情境从数字环境扩展到用户所处的物理环境。借助这些设备，计算机任务可以源于用户正在进行的日常活动，而不仅仅来自明确的指令。通过第一人称观察，智能体能够识别与用户请求相关的物体和活动，并将数字任务锚定在周围的物理情境中。我们将这种交互范式称为“自我使用”。然而，第一人称观察受限于佩戴者的视角，所提供的关于正在进行活动的证据可能不完整或存在歧义。随着新观察的不断到来，智能体可能需要修正其对物理情境和用户意图的理解，并重新评估先前的数字操作是否仍然有效。当前智能体能否可靠地应对这些变化，目前仍缺乏充分的评估。我们提出了EgoUseBench，这是一个用于评估“自我使用”能力的基准，涵盖三个相互关联（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个面向AI可穿戴设备“自我使用”交互范式的基准EgoUseBench，系统评估计算机使用智能体在第一人称观察持续演化的情况下，动态修正物理情境理解、用户意图以及先前数字操作有效性的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EgoUseBench, the first benchmark for the "Ego Use" interaction paradigm enabled by AI wearables, systematically evaluating how well computer-use agents revise their understanding of physical context and user intent, and reassess prior digital actions, as first-person observations evolve.
